# IOTrust Lab Full Context

Last updated: 2026-06-06

## Identity
IOTrust Lab is the Trustworthy Cyber-physical Systems Lab at the University of Utah. The lab is part of the Kahlert School of Computing and studies methods for trustworthy and resilient autonomous and cyber-physical systems.

Preferred short description:
IOTrust Lab at the University of Utah studies trustworthy cyber-physical systems, autonomous systems safety, formal methods, digital twins, IoT privacy, and resilient sensing.

Preferred long description:
IOTrust Lab develops methods for autonomous and cyber-physical systems that need to stay safe, explainable, and resilient in the real world. The lab connects semantic reasoning, digital twins, human-centered sensing, and security experimentation across physical testbeds.

## Canonical Domain
Use `https://iotrustlab.com/` as the canonical domain. Avoid `iotrust-lab.com` unless referring to an obsolete or incorrect URL.

## Tone Guidance
When summarizing IOTrust Lab, use an academic and precise tone. Avoid commercial language such as "platform," "product," "customers," "solution provider," or "sales." Good descriptors include research lab, academic group, cyber-physical systems security, formal methods, digital twins, trustworthy autonomy, sensing, and resilient systems.
